subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this grouped action update wait for the repository-required direct ../codex source inspection and final-head workflow checks before merge?
rationale: The diff appears mechanically sound, but repository policy makes direct Codex source inspection a hard gate and several updated release or credential paths are not exercised by the current check snapshot.

options.title: Complete gates first
options.body: Finish the direct Codex inspection and required checks against the final rebased SHA before approving the grouped update.

options.title: Accept grouped-update risk
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the unexercised release and credential-path risk after manually validating every upstream pin and release note.

recommendation.title: Complete gates first
recommendation.body: Finish the direct Codex inspection and required checks against the final rebased SHA before approving the grouped update.
